title: Hold a real estate, stock and station or strata managing agent's licence
what: Act as, or carry on business as, a real estate agent, stock and station agent or strata managing agent only under the matching licence.

sources.title: Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An individual must not act as or carry on the business of (or advertise, notify or state that the individual acts as or carries on the business of, or is willing to act as or carry on the business of)— (a) a real estate agent, unless the individual is the holder of a real estate agent's licence,

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. Section numbers read from the text and checked by hand. Section 8(1)(b) and (c) cover stock and station agents and strata managing agents in the same way; corporations are licensed under s 9 (not quoted).
